modules.sign_H1: H^1 of the triangle-filled GQ(4,2) point graph, dimension 64
modules.Levi_H1: H_1 of the GQ(4,2) Levi graph, dimension 64

theorem: The two independently constructed 64-dimensional binary cohomology carriers are isomorphic as PSp(4,3)-modules and as PGSp(4,3)-modules. The simultaneous common-generator intertwiner space has dimension one in each case, and its unique nonzero element is invertible of rank 64. Over F2 this gives a unique nonzero equivariant isomorphism.
boundary: This identifies the 64-dimensional sign-cohomology and Levi-homology modules. It does not identify either with the unrelated 5671-dimensional flag-graph H1 or imply a physical gauge field.
